summary: First testing pass on COSMIC HORA MVP. Ran 29 backend pytest cases (100% pass) covering health, auth (register/login/me/logout/duplicate/invalid), report-types (list/detail/404/admin CRUD), coupons (COSMIC20 validate + 20% math), full order lifecycle (create → pay → PDF), blogs, testimonials, FAQs, contact, appointments, analytics, settings, and admin authorization (401/403). Playwright frontend E2E covered homepage hero, /reports (15 cards) + search filter, all static pages (/privacy /terms /refund /faq /contact /appointment /about /services /pricing /blog + /blog/:slug), full user journey (register → birth form → COSMIC20 coupon applied → mocked payment → completed order → PDF download button → dashboard shows completed order), and admin console (login redirects to /admin, sidebar visible, all 11 admin nav pages load without errors, analytics chart renders with real data). All flows PASS end-to-end. Mocked Razorpay payment, mocked email delivery, and mock astrology report generation all work as documented per the spec.

issues: Amount displays as ₹2399.2 (bare float). Consider formatting to ₹2,399 or ₹2,399.00 for polish
Tooltip shows raw revenue: 7197.599999999999 (float precision). Should round to 2 decimals for display

action_items: (Polish, non-blocking) Round/format currency amounts in dashboard order list and admin analytics tooltip to 2 decimals (avoid raw float 7197.599999999999 and 2399.2 display)

(Consideration) CORS_ORIGINS is set to '*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject per CORS spec. Not blocking in current setup because the app uses Bearer tokens in localStorage and everything is served from the same origin via ingress, so credentials-mode requests are not needed. If cross-origin cookie usage is ever required, replace '*' with an explicit origin list.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1002 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth.py, orders.py, admin.py, cms.py) for maintainability once >700 line threshold.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' + allow_credentials=True is spec-invalid; browsers ignore credentials with wildcard. Currently harmless because frontend uses Bearer header, but should be tightened.

Payment endpoint runs _generate_and_store_report synchronously — for real external APIs with 30s timeout this will block the pay request. Consider background task (asyncio.create_task or FastAPI BackgroundTasks) once the real astrology API is wired.

PDF generation uses order.get('report_text') directly in Paragraph — the mock text contains raw HTML tags which ReportLab parses; safe for now but real external report bodies must be sanitized (no <script>, unclosed tags, etc.) before passing to Paragraph.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@cosmichora.com / Admin@Cosmic2026 — verified. Test users are created dynamically via /api/auth/register with random @example.com emails (pydantic EmailStr rejects .test TLD, so use example.com).
seed_data_creation: None. Backend seeds itself on startup (15 report types, COSMIC20 coupon, sample blog, testimonials, FAQs). Test suite creates one throwaway user per session + one order (with COSMIC20) + one throwaway blog/report-type/setting which are all cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py`. All 29 pass. Playwright verified full user + admin flows with data-testid selectors from the review request. Only cosmetic float formatting issues found. Mocked Razorpay / email / astrology API are working correctly per spec. No blockers.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Two minor polish items (float formatting in dashboard + analytics tooltip) are cosmetic only.
